verdict.rationale: Qapita's own cap table marketing says it gives investors a real-time view of ownership and serves as a single source of truth for founders, investors, and employees (qapita-docs-4, qapita-docs-6). That supports the core idea of investor self-service access to holdings, but only as one-line taglines. The investor portal with performance reports (qapita-docs-18) belongs to the VC/PE fund-administration offering, not startup cap table investors, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented per-investor portal login and holdings view for startup investors, structured investor updates/reporting from the company, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
